title: WellaPath Symptom Vocabulary (token_dictionary) — schema 2.0
description: Machine-validatable schema for token_dictionary artifacts at schema_version 2.0. Backward compatible with schema 1.0 consumers: the six legacy token arrays are still present and still required, with unchanged member type and ordering. Everything schema 2.0 adds lives under new top-level keys that a schema 1.0 consumer simply never reads. Prose field semantics live in schema/token_dictionary_schema_v2.0.json.

body_areas.description: Controlled vocabulary of body areas that token entries may associate to. Every body_area_id must also appear in body_area_tokens.

complaint_groups.description: Controlled vocabulary of complaint groups. Search/input grouping only — a complaint group is never a scoring input and is never referenced by rules.

tokens.description: One entry per stable token ID. The union of token_id values must be exactly the union of the six legacy arrays, with each entry's `category` naming the array it came from.

tokenId.description: Stable clinical identifier. lowercase_snake_case, ASCII only. Immutable once published — a token is deprecated and replaced, never renamed.

category.description: The legacy array this token belongs to. Fixed set — schema 2.0 adds no categories.

legacyTokenArray.description: Schema 1.0 compatibility surface. Array of stable token IDs, unique, order-significant: a schema 1.0 consumer reads these and nothing else.

release_status.description: candidate_unapproved -> approved_unpublished -> published. Only `published` may appear in a live /config manifest entry.

compatible_consumers.description: Consumer artifact versions this vocabulary has been reference-checked against by tools/check_compatibility.py.

legacy_metadata.description: Verbatim copy of the source artifact's _metadata block. Carried so the downgrade projection can reproduce the source file byte for byte. Never edited by hand.

clinicalReview.description: Review state. `status` may only be `reviewed` when reviewer, review_date and evidence are all non-null — enforced by tools/validate_vocabulary.py, which refuses to certify a review claim without evidence.

evidence.description: Pointer to the approval record (PR URL, issue URL, signed document reference). Null until one exists.

clinicalIdentity.description: CLINICAL. Everything a rule, a red flag or the scoring engine is permitted to depend on. Changing any field here is a clinical-token-identity change and blocks publication pending clinical review.

replaced_by.description: Successor token ID. Required non-null when status is `deprecated`, must be null when status is `active`. Replacement chains must be acyclic.

scoring_eligible.description: Whether this token ID may be referenced by kb/rules and contribute to scoring. Aliases are not tokens and can never be scoring-eligible — they have no entry of their own.

displayBlock.description: DISPLAY-ONLY. Never read by rules or scoring. Mobile may display `canonical_label` only when `display_safe` is true.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag for canonical_label and aliases. Only en-NG is defined at schema 2.0; additional locales require a schema bump so a consumer cannot silently receive text it cannot render.

searchBlock.description: SEARCH-ONLY. Never read by rules or scoring. `search_only: true` is a constant at schema 2.0 and is asserted by the validator.

normalized_form.description: normalize(token_id with underscores replaced by spaces), per docs/VOCABULARY_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.md. Generated, never authored.

aliases.description: Authored search phrases. Sorted by normalized form then by raw string, unique after normalization within the entry, and never equal to the entry's own canonical label after normalization.

associationsBlock.description: SEARCH/INPUT metadata. Filtering, grouping and picker routing only. No field here may affect scoring, red-flag evaluation or urgency at schema 2.0.

body_areas.description: Body area IDs from the top-level body_areas vocabulary.

complaint_groups.description: Complaint group IDs from the top-level complaint_groups vocabulary.

severity_descriptors.description: Severity descriptors this token may be qualified by, drawn from severity_tokens. Descriptive only: attaching a descriptor here does not change any weight, rule or urgency tier.

duration_descriptors.description: Duration descriptors this token may be qualified by, drawn from duration_tokens. Descriptive only, same constraint as severity_descriptors.

provenance.description: Where this entry's content came from. Free text, but must be non-empty: an entry with no provenance cannot be published.

searchIndex.description: Generated inverted index. Fully derivable from `tokens` — tools/validate_vocabulary.py regenerates it and requires an exact match, so a hand-edited index is a validation failure rather than a silent behaviour change.

normalized_forms.description: normalized form -> candidate token IDs, in resolver order. More than one ID means the form is ambiguous and must not auto-resolve.
